portInfo.description: Known as the "City of Roses," a beautiful port destination with panoramic mountain views and excellent cruise facilities.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Check the daily programme for your berth and allow extra time on turnaround or tender days.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Molde waterfront / town centre walk — fjord and “222 peaks” panorama framing — ~60–120 min.
Atlantic Road scenic drive — needs a long call and confirmed coach timing.
Romsdalen / Trollstigen day trips — longer-call only; return buffers required.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask whether you are on Storkaia or Moldegård before assuming the 100 m centre walk.
